## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Aññaviññāpana* Sutta ("Asking for something else"), cataloged as Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga Nissaggiya Pācittiya 4 (Bi-Vb Np4), is a disciplinary rule from the Vinaya Piṭaka's Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga. The rule governs the proper conduct of nuns regarding requisites, stipulating that a nun who asks for one particular item, but upon receiving it declares that she wants something else, commits an offense requiring forfeiture of the item and formal confession (*nissaggiya pācittiya*). An English translation of the rule and its accompanying case material has been produced by Bhikkhu Brahmali.
